title: Prove exact block fitting rank under compatible port flags (no κ)
body:
## Summary

For every field K, directed zero mask Z, equal payload width d and prescribed complete flag at each port, prove the exact minimum block fitting rank

```text
min rank M = d mu_K(Z)
M_ii = I_d, M_ij = 0 on Z
M_ij(F_j^a) <= F_i^a for every i,j,a
```

Here mu_K(Z) is the scalar fitting minimum for the same mask. Flags may differ between ports. Blocks may be noncommuting, nonsymmetric and nondiagonalizable. Ordering by flag level exposes scalar fitting matrices on the block diagonal; a tensor lift attains the lower bound for every prescribed flag family. Commuting complex blocks are included. Noncommutation alone is insufficient for a vector advantage when compatible flags remain.

Claim type: scoped written mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Credit ywz65 / #2541 for the strict block-fitting interface and its particular-mask theorem; Aaron Wang / navinor #825 for the different framed-circuit common-flag obstruction; Cinna Davis for the retained field-line scalar-query repair and open operator-valued boundary; Bukh, Cox and Blasiak for the classical fractional Haemers framework. Elementary triangular rank and simultaneous triangularization facts are classical. The new contribution is this exact arbitrary-directed-mask interface with prescribed port-dependent flags. Global literature priority is unclaimed. No predecessor scientific verifier or result is audited or replayed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362968). The result matches its scope. Canonical base and submission refresh: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. The card explicitly changes to an algebraic boundary result; research stopped at the first verified step.

## Evidence

- Before, scalar fitting floors and unrestricted vector codes left the compatible-flag boundary unstated. After, PROOF.md proves the exact all-field, all-mask, all-width minimum for this class and gives its sharp attainer.
- Exhaustive F2 checks cover all 64 directed three-port masks, 729 scalar fitting cases and 531,441 width-two upper-triangular block cases. Every block minimum is twice its scalar minimum. A separate full row-image oracle checks 512 scalar matrices and 127 selected full block matrices.
- Another 90 charted attainer/extension cases cover F2,F3,F5 and widths 2,3,4. The two sharp fixtures include noncommuting blocks and differing port flags without a global binary flag. The classical C5 boundary rejects all 243 local binary flag tuples. Nine domain/semantic controls pass.
- CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64, standard library only. Both exact VERIFY.json commands passed locally, timed at 2.639 s normal and 2.634 s optimized, below their individual 120-second limits. Their generated seven-file SHA256 receipts are byte-identical. These are check durations, not a speedup claim.
- Registered metadata/pins and normal/optimized replay pass. The committed-byte and declared-source-history check passes for all seven files at `e95d4665ecc67808d6cf4344b6f2fe6f1300768c`. Static syntax/function-size inspection and staged whitespace checks pass; no separate static analyzer is claimed.
- The official committed export passes integrity and declared-input coverage. Its optimized replay from a read-only Git-free directory produces the same complete receipt. There are no external live inputs or predecessor executable imports.
- The selected binding baseline passed for metadata orientation only.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -X dev -I -B research/compatible-flag-fitting-rank/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -X dev -I -O -B research/compatible-flag-fitting-rank/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compatible-flag-fitting-rank
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/compatible-flag-fitting-rank --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 installation may replace the absolute interpreter path. Expected markers are `PASS_COMPATIBLE_FLAG_FITTING_RANK`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Direct verification writes no files and emits its generated hash-bound receipt on stdout.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Compatible complete flags, equal payload dimensions, identity diagonal blocks and the declared directed zero mask define the theorem. Flags over an extension L give the scalar minimum over L; no automatic base-field substitution is made. The finite checks corroborate the written proof rather than prove its unbounded quantifiers.

No efficient scalar-minimum or flag-finding algorithm, unrestricted flag-breaking lower bound, unequal-width theorem, native implementation, physical caller, complete signed invoice or supplier admission is supplied. All five framework assumptions remain. Selected/historical scientific replays, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can a useful changed decoder break every compatible port-flag system and win after physical costs? Start with a literal small completed fitting matrix and query factorization, then price source access, payload volume, native charts and restoration. Absence of a supplied flag does not prove that no compatible flags exist. A favorable actual caller and complete invoice remain blockers.

## Related open work

- #1037 proves unrestricted block fitting rank for actual Turyn profile masks in characteristic two. This result restricts blocks by compatible port flags and applies to arbitrary directed masks; no Turyn quantity is recomputed or compared.
- #3045 studies fitting pairing matrices and per-term binary COPY floors for square E8 root-code decoders. It uses a different rank/cost contract; this package gives no E8 COPY number.
- #2832 studies scalar masked E8 decoders, projection transfer and batching reductions. It does not provide this prescribed-port-flag block fitting theorem, and this package does not settle its native COPY conjectures.
- #6461 studies the thirteen-line ternary Gram identity with at most four scalar terms and full-orthogonality binary COPY cost. The identity, optimization quantity and tariff differ from the present block fitting rank. No common-instance number is computed.
- #6439 studies positive-Gram Turyn encoders and redundancy support bills. Its metric and fixed-kernel support contract differs from the present identity-diagonal, directed-zero-mask block interface.

The live overlap scan and current-main general-mask/flag/formula searches found no competing compatible-flag fitting-rank target. Sparse notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits. No extra computations checked another contribution's numbers.

The completion refresh listed all account open PRs and checked the seven other submissions created since the advance CLAIM. They concern parity-cut tails, characteristic-five replay, dyadic cyclic balancing, frame506 routing, observable-mask preparation, frozen-snapshot channel capacity and multiplication-tensor reconstruction. None studies this compatible-port-flag fitting-rank quantity. No additional common-instance number was computed or compared.

The checks were read once after completion; run metadata confirms completed success and the same head. Local registered checks, committed-byte/source-history validation and the read-only Git-free export replay also pass. CI certifies execution of the registered finite checks and source bindings; it does not establish independent mathematical acceptance.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** isolated.

Seven new files under `research/compatible-flag-fitting-rank/`. Archive retention would not establish supplier admission. Frozen sources and the selected result retain their bytes.
